title: Fresh-clone installation, compatibility, release evidence, and rollback lock
invariants: A lock is bound to the exact AR-0027 revision, project revision digest, worktree key, and specification digest.
Installation is reproducible only when a clean-checkout recipe has bounded exact dependency versions and digests, and requires no network or credentials.
Compatibility declarations are explicit, versioned, and fail closed when a required contract is missing, changed, or outside its declared range.
Release evidence records an exact source head, signature and DCO observations, while publication and remote verification remain not_performed and unverified.
Rollback is prepared only for the exact qualified source head and cannot mutate durable state or claim that rollback was executed.
Every observation is single-use, digest-bound, privacy-safe, and rejected on stale, replayed, interrupted, unauthorized, or crossed input.

failure_semantics.side_effects: No installation, package-manager, Git, provider, network, process, LLM, Coordinator, AWQ, AWG, UI, publication, or durable-state operation is performed.

privacy.allowed_values: bounded identifiers, versions, enumerations, booleans, finite limits, and SHA-256 digests

limitations: A passing record qualifies supplied contract observations only; it does not install from a clone, inspect a filesystem, execute a test, or verify dependency provenance.
Signature and DCO values are supplied observations; the checker does not verify cryptographic signatures or contact Git hosting.
Publication remains not_performed and remote verification remains unverified; no release is claimed.
Rollback is an exact-target preparation record, not an executed rollback or proof of recovery. Coordinator, AWQ, AWG, and UI remain authoritative.
follow_up: AR-0028 may register the runtime and define ongoing release maintenance after independent review.
